description: This script manages a series of tests for a concurrent git-svn dcommit process, including setting up SVN repository hooks to emulate failures or concurrency, and performing various commit scenarios to test behavior under concurrent modifications.

methods.name: next_N
methods.description: Increment the counter variable N used for naming cloned repositories.

methods.name: setup_hook
methods.description: Configure SVN hooks (pre-commit or post-commit) to simulate commit failures or concurrent commits for testing purposes.

methods.name: check_contents
methods.description: Verify that the contents in working directories match the expected 'file' and 'auto_updated_file' after SVN operations.

methods.name: delete_first_line
methods.description: Remove the first line from a specified file to simulate changes for testing non-conflicting concurrent commits.
